correctness.rationale: PASS. Rank/chain displacement shows an inverse-generating partial injection with a genuine chain has precisely f and f⁻¹ as generators. Group-type elements are permutations on a recovered support; cyclic subgroups give the totient-corrected sum. Hence M_n=(I_n−U_n)/2+∑_r binom(n,r)c_r with c_r=∑_{λ⊢r}r!/(z_λ φ(lcmλ)). A nilpotent partial injection is disjoint union of directed chains and has EGF exp(z/(1−z)); only the empty map is group-type nilpotent, giving Z_n=(A_n+1)/2. Saddle analysis of (1−z)^−β exp(z/(1−z)) gives I_n/n!~e^(2√n−1/2)/(2√π n^1/4) and A_n/n!~e^(2√n−1/2)/(2√π n^3/4); thus Z_n/M_n~n^−1/2. Independent literal closure enumeration n=1..5 verified M=2,6,24,126,838 and Z=1,2,7,37,251; not a proof of asymptotics.
